title: Lime and Lilac Cards in Figma on a Laptop
whatItIs: A candid photo of a laptop showing Figma with a dark UI board of interlocking cards in lilac, lime and cream: revenue chart, transactions, currency exchange, credit card info, a family saving dot chart and a Space Grotesk specimen, with toys on a shelf behind.
whatItMeans: A real-life shot of a work-in-progress adds authenticity, and the bright cards read clearly even at an angle.
techniques: Photograph of a live design file for a behind-the-scenes feel
